image_description: A close-up portrait of a weasel (likely stoat/ermine in summer coat) facing left. The animal has brown dorsal fur and lighter ventral fur, a pointed snout, small dark eye, and rounded ear. Superimposed over the neck and chest area is nonsensical, gibberish text that appears to be an AI artifact mimicking handwriting or watermarks.

The visible eye is small, dark, and bead-like, matching the taxonomy.
The ear on the visible side is short, low-profile, and rounded.

The fur texture immediately surrounding the gibberish text appears slightly smudged and less defined than the rest of the coat, suggesting the text was generated as part of the texture rather than being a separate layer.
